recipe.scope: Two authored connected curve scales on one shared measured broad shoulder; same recipe on both inputs
recipe.lineage: Additional scalar pass on actual incoming BROAD_ACTIVE G06; no refinement and generation remains 6
recipe.amplitude_scope: Fine-pass amplitude is an explicit comparison condition; no legacy .65 total-shift design requirement
recipe.normal_scope: Caller applies height along actual incoming G06 pooled normals and performs constructive material X/Y geometry reflection
recipe.width_scope: Halfwidth is a fraction of measured G03 transverse surface arc, not an exact perpendicular geodesic distance

actual_surface_pass.scope: One uncapped source-G6 addition; operator amplitudes belong to the saved recipe, not inherited total caps.
